_comment: DO NOT USE FOR NOW. In this install TripoSG returns a cage of fragments filling its bounding cube instead of the subject, whatever the input. Tested 2026-09-10 on one character concept: a plain grey background, a white background, a transparent RGBA cut-out, square framing and use_flash_decoder=false all failed the same way, while img2mesh_trellis.json made a clean mesh from the same image. The weights match Hugging Face byte for byte, so the fault is in the pipeline code or its dependencies, not the download. Use img2mesh_trellis.json instead: MIT, no territory clause, and it removes the background itself. LICENCE: TripoSG is MIT upstream, but the copy vendored in this pack ships a Tencent licence file with the EU, UK and South Korea exclusion; see docs/guide/licensing. SHAPE ONLY: it returns vertex colours, not a texture map.
